note: Five sample questions only, for interface demonstration. The approved production requirement is 15 defensible questions per equipment, derived solely from that equipment Full Details screen; this is not yet met.

questions.question: Which Apollo missions used the Lunar Roving Vehicle on the Moon?
questions.explanation: The Lunar Roving Vehicle was used on Apollo 15, Apollo 16 and Apollo 17.

questions.question: Which crewed mission visited Surveyor 3 and returned selected components to Earth?
questions.explanation: Apollo 12 astronauts visited Surveyor 3 and returned selected parts for examination.

questions.question: What kind of evidence did Spirit help reveal about ancient Mars?
options: Evidence that Mars was once much wetter
questions.explanation: Spirit found strong clues that Mars was once much wetter than it is today.

questions.question: What did the Phoenix lander confirm beneath the Martian surface near its landing site?
questions.explanation: Phoenix confirmed water ice beneath the surface in the Martian arctic.

questions.question: What was InSight primarily designed to investigate?
questions.explanation: InSight studied Mars’s interior using seismic and heat-flow investigations.
